# h3spec cases scripts/interop-http3.sh expects to fail, one per line, each
# under the reason it is not a defect. A line is a case's full name as
# h3spec's "Failures:" section prints it after the case number.

# RFC 9114 §7.2.4: refusing a repeated setting identifier is a MAY. The
# server refuses repeats among identifiers below 64, where every setting
# RFC 9114 and RFC 9204 define lives; this case repeats 0x40, a setting the
# server ignores either way (h3uni.go, settings).
HTTP/3 servers treats a repeated setting identifier as an error whatever its value [HTTP/3 7.2.4.1]

# The case announces a GOAWAY of 1 GiB on the control stream and wants
# H3_EXCESSIVE_LOAD, which RFC 9114 §10.5 makes a MAY. The server buffers
# nothing and closes at once with H3_FRAME_ERROR (0x106): a frame longer than
# the field it carries is a layout fault, which §7.1 makes H3_FRAME_ERROR.
HTTP/3 servers MUST NOT buffer a frame longer than SETTINGS_MAX_FIELD_SECTION_SIZE [HTTP/3 7.1]
